title: distephanus rochonioides
intro: Distephanus rochonioides, commonly known as a plant species in the Asteraceae family, is a medicinal herb native to tropical regions. It has been used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Distephanus rochonioides include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, which helps in managing symptoms of fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
